subject: maths
question: A metallic cone of radius 16 cm and height 36 cm is melted and made into spheres of radius 4 cm each. How many spheres are there?
solution:
Given:

Radius of cone (r) = 16 cm

Height of cone (h) = 36 cm

Radius of sphere (R) = 4 cm

Concept:

Spheres are to be made from the metallic cone. Hence, the volume of all the spheres made would be equal to the volume of the metallic cone.

Formula:

Volume of Cone = 1over 3 × π × r2 × h, where

r = radius of cone, h = height of cone

Volume of sphere = 4over 3 × π × R3, where

R = Radius of the sphere

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff4324b90bf6c37431732ee8ab1116a52c8ee7f54b9d1a28e814d45a8fe4961.png] 

Volume of sphere = 4over 3 × 3.14 × 4 × 4 × 4 = 267.95 cm3

Let the total number of spheres cast be "n".

Volume of metallic cone = 1over 3 × 3.14 × 16 × 16 × 36 = 9,646.08 cm3

According to the question-

Volume of cone = Volume of one sphere × Total number of spheres cast

⇒ 9,646.08 cm3 = 267.95 cm3 × n

⇒ n = 9,646.08over 267.95 = 36 

∴ The total number of spheres cast will be 36.
